excerpt_zh: 面向住宅与商业空间的地板项目咨询，协助沟通现场条件、材料方向、施工范围和报价需求。
excerpt_en: Flooring project consultation for homes and commercial spaces, covering site conditions, material direction, scope discussions, and quotation requirements.
content_zh:
地板项目需要结合现场条件、使用需求与整体装修安排。FLASH CAST 会先了解空间情况，再沟通材料方向、施工范围和报价需求。

请提交地区、空间类型、面积和现场照片，便于安排下一步咨询。
content_en:
Every flooring project should take site conditions, everyday use, and the wider renovation plan into account. FLASH CAST first reviews your space, then discusses material direction, scope, and quotation requirements.

Share your location, space type, area, and site photos so we can arrange the next consultation.

faqs_en.a: Please share your location, space type, area, and site photos. We will review the requirements and arrange the next discussion.
faqs_en.q: What details are useful for a flooring consultation?
